name: casual first-person blog
text: Honestly, I didn't expect the trip to go this well. We missed the first train, so I grabbed coffee and we just wandered around the station for an hour. It's funny how the best parts of a trip are the ones you don't plan. I'd go back tomorrow if I could. My sister's already asking when we're going again, and I don't have an answer yet. I'm thinking spring. We'll see.

name: formal third-person report
text: The committee reviewed the quarterly expenditure data submitted by each regional office. Expenditure exceeded the approved allocation in three regions, primarily as a consequence of unanticipated infrastructure maintenance. The committee recommends that regional directors submit revised forecasts prior to the next review period. Furthermore, procurement procedures should be standardised across all offices in order to ensure consistent reporting and appropriate oversight of contractual obligations.

name: chatty second-person tutorial
text: Ready to make your first commit? Open your terminal and type git status. You'll see the files you changed in red. Want to save them? Type git add and the file name, then run git status again. See how they turned green? That means you've staged them. Now you can commit. Don't worry if you make a mistake, you can always undo it later.

name: academic prose
text: Although the relationship between socioeconomic status and educational attainment has been extensively documented, considerably less attention has been devoted to the mechanisms through which institutional characteristics mediate this association. This study therefore examines longitudinal administrative data from secondary schools, employing multilevel regression models that account for the hierarchical structure of the observations. The findings indicate that institutional resources substantially moderate the association, particularly among students from disadvantaged backgrounds.

name: terse technical notes
text: Server restarted at noon. Cache cleared. Memory usage dropped to forty percent. Disk still near full. Logs rotated manually. Backup job failed twice. Root cause unknown. name: hedging cautious memo
text: Based on the figures available, it appears the rollout is probably on schedule, though delays seem possible. Furthermore, regarding the launch date, perhaps the assumptions should be revisited before a final decision is made. It would also be sensible to share an updated memo next week, pending further review from the product and engineering leads. Please confirm receipt of this memo by Friday.

name: narrative fiction with dialogue
text: The rain hammered the rooftop all evening. Eliza peered through the window and frowned. 'I told you not to go,' she said, her voice barely audible over the storm. He shook his head and smiled. 'I had to try,' he answered. 'Stay,' she whispered. She didn't answer; she just watched the water run down the glass in crooked lines, thinking of the walk they had missed.
